mapper.insert: INSERT INTO std_customer ( customer_id, customer_name, mobile_phone_number, email, birth_date, gender, road_address, registered_at, modified_at, active, source_system, event_type, extracted_at, consumed_at ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{mobilePhoneNumber}, #{email}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{roadAddress}, #{registeredAt}, #{modifiedAt}, #{active}, #{sourceSystem}, #{eventType}, #{extractedAt}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (customer_id) DO UPDATE SET customer_name = EXCLUDED.customer_name, mobile_phone_number = EXCLUDED.mobile_phone_number, email = EXCLUDED.email, birth_date = EXCLUDED.birth_date, gender = EXCLUDED.gender, road_address = EXCLUDED.road_address, registered_at = EXCLUDED.registered_at, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, active = EXCLUDED.active, source_system = EXCLUDED.source_system, event_type = EXCLUDED.event_type, extracted_at = EXCLUDED.extracted_at, consumed_at = now()
